newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil cenbank sells 7.1 bln reais in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil cenbank sells 7.1 bln reais in bonds.

text.p: Brazil's Central bank sold 7.1 billion reais in 56-day and 182-day Central bank Bonds (BBCs) at its weekly bond auction Tuesday, dealers said.
The Central Bank sold 5.3 billion reais in 56-day bonds at an overnight rate of 2.406 percent a month, down from 2.4535 percent last week.
The 102-day bonds were sold at 2.311 percent a month, down from 2.324 percent a week before. The total of the 102-day bonds was 1.8 billion reais.
The auction's result was in line with market expectations, dealers said.
The financial result of the auction suggested 100 million reais will be drained from the banking system as 7.0 billion reais in 56-day bonds are coming due Wednesday.
